bg.$description: Ground. The page background beneath every surface. Dark is the default theme.

fg.$description: Text rank 1 (highest). Titles and primary content.

dim.$description: Text rank 2. Body copy, one step below --fg.

mute.$description: Text rank 3. Secondary prose, one step below --dim.

faint.$description: Text rank 4 (lowest). Section numbers, meta labels, captions.

border.$description: Line. The default edge — --border-2 is emphasised over this one.

border-2.$description: Line. An edge that has to be found — emphasised over --border.

panel.$description: Surface. A fill laid over the ground as a translucent layer — panels, cards, table rows.

panel-2.$description: Surface, emphasised over --panel. Hover and active state for panels, rows and secondary/ghost buttons.

bracket.$description: The corner-bracket mark drawn around visualization frames and telemetry panels — a decorative line, distinct from --border.

glow.$description: The ambient radial-gradient tint behind the workspace header.

accent.$description: Amber. The primary accent: the colour of acting.

accent-2.$description: Ice. The secondary accent: the colour of referring.
